# vitOTT / Vital DSP attribution

The multiband compressor and crossover DSP sources in `vital_dsp/` are derived
from the GPLv3-licensed vitOTT project by Yegor Suslin, which in turn contains
DSP code from Vital by Matt Tytel.

Upstream project: https://github.com/edgjj/vitOTT

The complete license text is included in `LICENSE` and at the repository root.
